$comment: AIDD machine-tunable configuration. Copy to .aidd/config.json and edit.
Boundary rule: this file holds routing a script reads on every dispatch;
constitution.md holds policy a human must approve (budgets, gates, rigor).
Provider credentials are read from the environment ONLY and must never
appear here - `aidd-route.sh audit` fails the run if they do.
Rates are USD per million tokens, published list price at the version below.
A model with no rate entry records `na` in the cost ledger, never 0.
